references.text: Parallel text mentioning the Levitical cities given to Aaron's descendants, including Anathoth with its pasturelands
The prophet Jeremiah was from Anathoth in the land of Benjamin, the city mentioned here as a priestly city
Anathoth is mentioned as one of the cities in Benjamin, the same city assigned to the priests here
The priest Abiathar was sent to Anathoth by Solomon, the city that was a priestly city in the tribe of Benjamin
Anathoth is mentioned as one of the cities in Benjamin's inheritance, which later were given to the priests
